blush-paper.$description: Blush Paper — Page canvas, section backgrounds, the warm field all content lives on

coral-crimson.$description: Coral Crimson — All headings, body text, icons, and the sole action color — the entire voice of the brand

midnight-ink.$description: Midnight Ink — Deep accent for select surfaces and inverse contexts, a cool counterpoint to the warm field

pure-white.$description: Pure White — Image backgrounds, inline accents, negative space within photographs and cards

soft-black.$description: Soft Black — Decorative strokes, icon fills, hairline borders — the only place pure black appears

sansita.$description: Display and heading face — bold, slightly condensed, with -0.02em tracking that tightens at every size. Carries all editorial weight: the page announces itself through this one confident voice.

nunito-sans.$description: Body and UI face — the 18px body sets a generous reading rhythm at 1.5 line-height; 700 weight for emphasized inline phrases and small caps headers. The 72px outlier is likely a single oversized numeral or pull-quote.

clarkson.$description: Secondary prose — the slightly taller 1.7 line-height is for long-form letter passages where breathing room matters more than density
